The rash label for R21 is an interpretation, since R21 is rash, which is correct, but the Z09 'follow-up' visits are weak evidence of simplicity.","Formal cited claims (C0125077, C0125095) are single-condition diabetes patients, which do not clearly illustrate the low-complexity point as well as the 0-condition claims would.","Calling C0125950 a 'single-condition depression visit' is fine, but the 'templated notes' inference from 2 of 21 is speculative, though flagged as weak.","Headline 'at every complexity level' is an interpretation of the comparison rates; the 0-condition band at 12.7% is cited against 1.8%, which supports it, but the text claims 'several times' in every band, whereas 5+ is 46.3% vs 21.1%, about 2.2 times, so it is only roughly double there."]}
